messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] the status is RUNNING also if I NOT USING IT !!
parts:
Hi Nino,
Thanks for the note.  We haven't started enforcing any of the limits we have on the accounts.  We will be phasing that in over the coming months.  An application is running when someone is accessing it, and otherwise will be in a sleeping state.  You can always terminate an application if you are no longer using it which would stop it as well.

Hope this helps.
-Tareef
